items.title: Sep24 Nikkei +0.76% but TOPIX -0.39%; AI/semiconductor concentration confirmed
items.summary: Nikkei closed 65,513.99 (+495.04), while TOPIX fell to 4,075.30; Prime decliners 838 exceeded advancers 674. Electrical equipment +1.67% and precision +1.73%, while banks -1.66%, insurance -2.89%, mining -2.21%.

items.title: US stocks finish flat-to-lower as oil and Treasury yields stay elevated
items.summary: S&P 500 -0.02%, Nasdaq +0.01%, Dow -0.31%; Brent rose over 3% near $107 and long yields rose. Markets price roughly 70% chance of another Fed hike next month.

items.title: Meta +4.5%, AMD +2.4%; AI demand narrative survives macro pressure
items.summary: AI leaders were mixed but selected AI names remained strong despite higher yields; supports selective rather than broad Japan AI continuation.

items.title: Japan Oracle Q1 ordinary profit +24.9%; operating margin improves
items.summary: FY2027 Q1 ordinary profit 26.6bn yen, +24.9% YoY; operating margin rose to 34.6% from 31.9%.

items.title: Furukawa Electric raises H1 net profit forecast 36.5% on UACJ share sale
items.summary: H1 net profit forecast 42.5bn to 58.0bn yen due about 22bn yen securities-sale gain; operating/ordinary profit and full-year forecasts unchanged, so this is not treated as operating earnings acceleration.

items.title: Mizuho to cancel 1.0% of outstanding shares
items.summary: Cancellation of 24,352,700 treasury shares planned Oct23. Positive capital-policy signal, but Sep24 bank sector fell 1.66%, so sector confirmation remains required.

items.title: Shimizu announces 100bn yen convertible bonds
items.summary: Proceeds earmarked mainly for M&A and share repurchases; dilution/hedging effects make near-term stock impact two-sided.
